one_line_description.value: Supabase is a backend platform providing a full Postgres database per project along with Realtime, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, and APIs.
one_line_description.quote: Build with a complete backend platform, from your database to your application logic. Supabase provides a full Postgres database for every project with Realtime functionality, database backups, extensions, and more.

has_public_api.quote: Supabase also has a Management API to help with managing your Supabase Platform, and a CLI for local development and CI workflows.

api_breadth.value: Broad multi-product surface: Management API for organizations/projects plus client libraries covering Postgres Database, Auth, and Realtime.
api_breadth.quote: The Supabase client libraries help you interact with Supabase products, such as the Postgres Database, Auth, and Realtime. They are available in several popular programming languages.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: Tokens generated via OAuth2 are short-lived and tied to specific scopes to ensure your app can only perform actions that are explicitly approved by the user.

access_notes.value: Free plan is self-serve with a limit of 2 active projects and pausing after 1 week of inactivity; paid Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans unlock higher quotas, SSO, PrivateLink, and HIPAA add-on.
access_notes.quote: Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity. Limit of 2 active projects.

official_mcp_server.quote: The hosted Supabase MCP server is available at `https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp`.

rate_limits.value: Management API: 120 requests per minute per user, per project or organization, per endpoint; HTTP 429 after exceeding the limit.
rate_limits.quote: | 120 requests | 1 minute | Per user, per project or organization, per endpoint |

webhooks.quote: Database Webhooks allow you to send real-time data from your database to another system whenever a table event occurs.

sandbox_or_test_env.quote: You can use these branching environments to create and test changes like new configurations, database schemas, or features without affecting your production setup.

sdk_languages.quote: JavaScript - Flutter - Python - C# - Swift - Kotlin

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Legacy anon and service_role JWT API keys are being deprecated by the end of 2026 in favor of publishable and secret keys; no broader API versioning or sunset policy was found in the supplied evidence.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: Deprecation: Supabase is deprecating the `anon` and `service_role` keys by the end of 2026.

verdict_reason: Supabase publishes extensive public developer docs, a self-serve Free plan with unlimited API requests, OAuth2 and API-key authentication, official SDKs in six languages, and an official hosted MCP server. Access is not gated by sales contact, partner approval, or app review.
open_questions: No community/third-party MCP servers were returned in the evidence bundle (MCP registry empty and GitHub repositories not checked), so community_mcp_servers is recorded as not found.
The docs list both Data REST API and GraphQL API; the evidence did not establish whether the GraphQL API is auto-generated or its full breadth, so api_type records REST as the primary type.

API key authentication (publishable/secret keys) is documented on the API keys page separately from the Management API bearer/OAuth2 token page; auth_methods combines both mechanisms and is therefore medium confidence.
The Management API rate limits are documented, but whether the Management API is plan-gated is not explicitly stated beyond the pricing page noting that all plans include unlimited API requests.
